correctness.rationale: Saturation and exclusion of unused endpoint symbols give a unique (A,B,T) representation; the objective is exact. The strict two-orientation rigidity for every q>=6, the exceptional q4/q5 mixed families, and complete labeled enumeration for all alphabet and length parameters provide a natural full classification with a real finite/infinite structural boundary.
